description: Activate a previously created child account for this session by minting and installing its owner-signed live key. After this, fund_market/place_order/etc. operate on the child. The child owner key is derived locally and never reaches Felix.

force_remint.description: Discard any cached credential for this child and mint a fresh one. Use after the account's scopes, caps, or mandate change; otherwise the cached key is reused.

name: use_child_account
